reviewBasis: Editorial summaries of public material recorded in the November 12, 2026 Facebook pilot and its documented follow-up. The collector reports source rereads for selected records; other records received group or file checks only. Harbor’s editorial reviewer assessed those records and did not independently revisit Facebook pages. Explicit supplemental assignments distinguish the NewBridge nursing unit and Edelweiss assisted living from the original search targets. This qualitative material does not change the consumer experience index or CMS ratings. Counts describe captured observations, not independent people or verified households.
